name: Get Current User
description: Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated Jira user. The returned `accountId` is the correct identifier for fields like `lead_account_id` in JIRA_CREATE_PROJECT, JIRA_ADD_WATCHER_TO_ISSUE, and JIRA_REMOVE_WATCHER_FROM_ISSUE — never use email or username in those fields.

expand.description: Comma-separated list of user properties to expand, e.g., 'groups', 'applicationRoles'. Omitting this parameter returns only the base user profile without group membership or role data.
expand.title: Expand

inputParameters.title: GetMyselfRequest
inputParameters.description: Defines the request parameters for retrieving details of the currently authenticated Jira user.

error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action
error.title: Error

successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
successful.title: Successful
